notes: Every base screen now has a Services package for its size: FOBs run engineers; camps add sustainment, MPs and a medical company; major bases add intelligence, civil affairs and C-RAM. Implement them all in one tap
Services the base is too small for are greyed out with the size they need; expand the base (with engineers, or contractors if none are there) to unlock them
Repair all damage in one tap, and the Services rail lists every base with these actions side by side
